title: Preparation of Adult Human Kidney Tissue for Single Nucleus RNA-seq and Other Multiomics Studies
author: Sanjay Jain
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.568g9hw
materials: Keep the prepared coverslips at Room temperature .

steps.title: Prepare Cryomolds
steps.instruction: Prepare two cryomolds for tissue embedding.

substeps.instruction: Label one cryomold with the specimen number and place it on powdered dry ice.
Fill a second cryomold with O.C.T. to serve as a bathing cassette.

steps.title: Dissect and Bath Tissue
steps.instruction: Rapidly dissect the tissue and prepare it for embedding.

substeps.instruction: Dab away excess blood using a pad or gauze.
Cut a section of desired size that fits easily in the labeled cryomold.
Briefly bathe the tissue in the O.C.T. (from the second cryomold) for 00:02:00, gently swishing with a clean instrument.
Optional: Capture an image of the tissue while bathing using a smartphone for gross identification of cortex and documentation.

steps.title: Embed and Freeze Tissue
steps.instruction: Embed the tissue in O.C.T. and freeze it slowly.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the tissue into the pre-labeled, chilled cryomold.
Orient the tissue as desired and pour O.C.T. until the tissue is completely covered, removing bubbles with forceps or a pipette tip.
Place the cassette on powdered dry ice in a covered bucket to maintain a cold environment.
Avoid flash freezing to prevent tissue fracturing.

steps.title: Store or Ship Frozen Block
steps.instruction: Secure the frozen block for storage or transport.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the frozen block into a pre-chilled ziplock bag on dry ice.
Seal the bag, removing as much air as possible.
Store in a freezer box at -80 °C or ship overnight in a Styrofoam container with ample dry ice.

steps.title: Prepare Cryostat and Instruments
steps.instruction: Set up the cryostat and sanitize tools.

substeps.instruction: Acclimate O.C.T. blocks in the cryostat for approximately 00:10:00 (typical temperature: -20 °C to -25 °C).
Prepare necessary tubes, slides, and containers.
Spray all instruments (forceps/paintbrushes) with RNaseZAP at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount Tissue Block
steps.instruction: Attach the tissue block to the cryostat chuck.

substeps.instruction: Add O.C.T. to a pre-chilled metal chuck in the cryostat.
Place the O.C.T. block with the tissue facing up onto the chuck and allow it to freeze for a few minutes until attached.
Mount the chuck on the cryostat stage with the tissue facing the user.

steps.title: Collect Thick Section Rolls
steps.instruction: Collect 35-40 μm thick sections for RNA or protein studies in microfuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: For dry ice/no solution: Collect 7 rolled sections (total 280 μm) in a chilled 1.7 ml centrifuge tube. Keep chilled at all times and process immediately.
For RNAlater: Collect 7 rolled sections in a pre-chilled centrifuge tube containing 1 mL RNAlater. Keep chilled on ice; these may be stored at -20 °C or shipped overnight with ice packs.

steps.title: Collect Coverslip Sections
steps.instruction: Collect sections for DART-FISH on coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Section tissue at desired thickness (e.g., 10 μM or 20 μM).
Place the coverslip so the tissue is centered, then use forceps to flip the coverslip so the tissue faces upwards.
Keep chilled and avoid pressing firmly to prevent smashing the tissue.
Gently tilt the coverslip to allow the tissue to adhere via static.

steps.title: Collect Histology Slides
steps.instruction: Collect 5-10 μm sections on slides for validation.

substeps.instruction: Collect 1 section per slide at 3-5 slide intervals.
Briefly touch the back surface of the slide with a finger to facilitate tissue adherence.
H&E stain one slide from each interval for QA/QC; store the remainder in the cryostat and then transfer to -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Coverslips for Shipment
steps.instruction: Attach coverslips to slides for stable transport.

substeps.instruction: Place a slide in the cryostat until chilled.
Apply a drop of water (~25 µL) toward the center of the slide.
Place the coverslip (tissue facing upwards) over the water and keep flat until the water freezes.
Place the attached coverslip slides in a pre-chilled slide container for shipment or store at -80 °C.
